jobs.name: planner-working
jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: six-frame low-resolution pixel animation sprite atlas.
Edit target: the supplied selected SIX poses of the existing StudyGlass red panda, in THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, chronological reading order.
Primary request: retouch and simplify this existing character art for a true low-resolution 80x80 pixel canvas per frame. Preserve these exact SIX articulated poses and their chronology, costume, red panda identity, orange fur, cream muzzle/ears, dark plum limbs, striped bushy tail, and each pose's head/arm/leg positions. Keep framing and consistent body size, leave 10% transparent margins around every sprite. Keep all body parts and props INSIDE their own equal cell; remove neighboring sprite fragments.
Style: professional hand-placed 2D pixel sprite, strong clean dark plum outer contour 1-2 logical pixels, carefully connected pixel clusters, simple 3-shade orange volumes, cream cheek mask and clear expressive face. Restrained coherent palette around 24-32 colors. Draw on a visibly coarse 80x80 pixel grid for each tile then nearest-neighbor enlarge. Clean blocky pixel stair steps, absolutely no soft raster painting, no gradient/noise/fuzz, no voxel cubes, no generic geometric mascot. Eyes and contours must become MORE readable at small scale; remove redundant texture but retain personality and volume.
Output: ONLY the edited 3x2 sprite atlas on genuinely transparent background. No text, no labels, no grid, no decorative background. No additional poses.
The exact planner with black/plum rectangular glasses, teal scarf, beige clipboard, yellow pencil. Six acting beats: ready pencil down; pencil raised beside face; head down pencil on clipboard writing; satisfied wink/nod with pencil near chest; pencil paw raised triumphantly; lower pencil at side. Both glasses lenses have LARGE bright CYAN FOUR-POINT STAR glints with white cores except the closed/winking eye in frame4. Keep the distinct four rays readable, not round dots. Keep yellow pencil distinct from dark paw. No floating V, no fireworks.
